exercises.instruction: Write a script that accepts flags: -n for name, -a for age
exercises.instruction_id: Tulis script yang menerima flag: -n untuk nama, -a untuk umur

exercises.instruction: Write a script that processes all .txt files in a directory
exercises.instruction_id: Tulis script yang proses semua file .txt di direktori
exercises.shadow_text:
#!/bin/bash
for file in *.txt; do
  echo "Processing: $file"
  wc -l "$file"
done
exercises.hint: *.txt is a glob pattern matching all .txt files
exercises.hint_id: *.txt adalah glob pattern yang cocok semua file .txt

exercises.instruction: Write a script that monitors disk usage and alerts if > 80%
exercises.instruction_id: Tulis script yang monitor penggunaan disk dan alert jika > 80%
exercises.shadow_text:
#!/bin/bash
usage=$(df / | awk 'NR==2 {print $5}' | sed 's/%//')
if [ "$usage" -gt 80 ]; then
  echo 'WARNING: Disk usage is ${usage}%'
fi
exercises.hint: df shows disk free space, awk extracts columns
exercises.hint_id: df menunjukkan ruang disk kosong, awk ekstrak kolom
